title: LavaMoat Scenario Config Schema
description: Descriptor for a LavaMoat test scenario fixture (`scenario.json`). Each fixture directory under `fixtures/scenarios/<shared|core>/<group>/<slug>/` contains one of these alongside an `entry.js`. The scenario is executed under the policy in the fixture's `lavamoat/node/policy.json` (or an empty policy, if there is no such file) and its outcome is asserted against `expect`.

$schema.description: Location of this schema; lets editors validate the file. Ignored by the scenario loader.

name.description: Human-readable scenario name, used as the test title. By convention: `<group> - <short description>`.

expect.description: Expected outcome of the scenario run.

setupPath.description: Path, relative to the fixture directory, of a CommonJS module which is `require()`-d before `lockdown()` is called. It may assign properties to `globalThis` and/or (in `core/` fixtures only) export a `builtins` object of fake builtin modules. Omit if the scenario needs no setup.

scuttleGlobalThis.description: Options for scuttling `globalThis` during the scenario run. Scuttling is disabled if omitted.

globalThisRefs.description: Names of the properties which alias `globalThis` in the root compartment. Rarely needed.

ScenarioExpect.description: Expected outcome of a scenario run. Exactly one expectation shape must be used. The entry module's `module.exports` is JSON-serialized by the runner, so expectations are checked against the parsed JSON value.

ExpectResult.description: The scenario must complete without error and its result must deeply equal `result`.

result.description: Any JSON value (including `null`) to deep-equal against the scenario's result.

ExpectTruthy.description: The scenario must complete without error and its result must be truthy.

ExpectFalsy.description: The scenario must complete without error and its result must be falsy.

ExpectError.description: The scenario must throw, and the error's message must match a regular expression.

error.description: Source of a regular expression (as passed to `new RegExp()`, without delimiters or flags) which the thrown error's message must match.

LavaMoatScuttleOpts.description: Options for scuttling `globalThis`: making properties of the real global object inaccessible once the root compartment has been created.

exceptions.description: Properties of `globalThis` to exclude from scuttling.

scuttlerName.description: Name of a custom scuttler function, which must exist as a property of the global object (e.g. `x` means the function is taken from `globalThis.x`).

ScuttleException.description: A property name to exclude from scuttling. A string beginning with `/` is treated as a regular expression literal (`/pattern/flags`) and matched against property names.

GlobalThisRef.description: Name of a property which refers to the global object.
